name: Foxtrail-Tracker
description: Self-hosted list of the Swiss Foxtrail city trails (foxtrail.ch) you have completed - with date, number of players and notes, for several users with login. The trail list is synced with foxtrail.ch once a week; trails that disappear are archived, never deleted. Flask + SQLite, no external dependencies in the browser.

notes.text: A random admin password is generated during installation and shown at the end; it is also stored in `~/foxtrail-tracker.creds` inside the container. Set `var_admin_pass` up front to choose your own.
Private project, not affiliated with Foxtrail AG. The trail list is read from the public overview on foxtrail.ch once a week (`foxtrail-sync.timer`); run `foxtrailctl sync` for an immediate sync.
Behind a reverse proxy with TLS set `BIND=127.0.0.1:8080` and `FORCE_HTTPS=1` in `/etc/foxtrail-tracker.env`, then `systemctl restart foxtrail`.
